STATEMENT OF WORK (SYNTHETIC — CORE-200 TEST FIXTURE)
Solicitation No.: SYN-D-0004
Title: Fire-Control Radar and Weapons-Direction System Maintenance Support

1. SCOPE
This requirement covers corrective and preventive maintenance of
shipboard fire-control radar and weapons-direction system equipment
during in-port maintenance periods for notional surface combatants.

2. REQUIREMENTS
2.1 Contractor technicians shall execute fire-control system PMCS in
    accordance with the maintenance index page (MIP) and combat
    systems maintenance plan.
2.2 Contractor shall perform fire-control radar alignment and
    calibration and troubleshoot weapons-direction system faults.
2.3 Contractor shall log all maintenance actions in the ship's 3-M
    system for material condition tracking.

3. PLACE OF PERFORMANCE
Pierside, notional Naval Station, aboard assigned surface combatants.
